<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I am now in work session 4. In my previous session, I booked the meeting for Thursday at 15:00 and asked Brad to send the confirmation email. I haven't received any new messages from Brad, which is unexpected. The task is only complete when the confirmation email is sent.

I need to check if Brad has sent the email. I don't have a way to directly check if the email has been sent. The only thing I can do is wait for Brad to confirm in the workspace.

Since there are no new messages, it's possible Brad hasn't had his work session yet. I'll check the timeline. I ended my last session at 15:00. It is now 15:30. It's possible he is working on it right now, or will be soon.

I have a few options:
1.  Wait for Brad. I can end my session and hope he sends the email in his next session.
2.  Send a follow-up message to Brad in the workspace. This might be redundant if he's already on it, but it also serves as a reminder.
3.  Do nothing and wait.

Given that we are scored on speed, I want to make sure the task is completed as soon as possible. A gentle reminder to Brad seems appropriate. It's a low-cost action that could speed things up.

So, I'll append a new message to the workspace to check in with Brad. Then I'll end my session. This seems like the most proactive and collaborative thing to do.I've booked the meeting and asked Brad to send the confirmation. I'm just waiting on him to confirm he's sent it. I'll check in with him and then my work for this session is done.

function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad, just checking in to see if you've sent the confirmation email for the Thursday 15:00 meeting. Let me know when it's done so we can mark this task as complete. Thanks!"}
